cause: JOEWIN_NO_VT dropped all F1-F4 keydown and keyup messages before any typography handling.
fix: Plain F1/F2 change font size by one point; F3/F4 change line spacing by one pixel.
Rebuild fonts, grid and system caret in a fixed outer window; repaint immediately.
Keep glyph font height separate from row cell height so spacing does not resize bold/italic/wide variants.
Persist font size and signed line spacing in the existing JoeEditor registry profile.
Font size bounds 6-72 points, spacing upper bound 32 pixels, cell height lower bound 2 pixels.
test_coverage: Normal, Insert, Visual, command input, help, grep and maximized window.
Real WM_KEYDOWN/WM_KEYUP events, registry font/spacing values and fixed window rectangles.
Visible system caret dimensions change with font/line height; hidden grep caret dimensions are not used as a font measurement.
Grep remains modal and discards attempted text input.
Negative spacing, restart loading, subsequent editing/undo/selection and exact saved file bytes.
Probe waits for UI work completion and restores original font/spacing registry values.
limitations: The updated build was executed under Wine, not inside Windows XP. User reported the previous build works on XP except these keys.
The modern Visual Studio/WiX build was not executed.
build_note: Release standalone was rebuilt before the first successful probe. Its final incremental build was already up to date; release-build-summary.log records the successful RC/link summary and release-up-to-date-summary.log records the final exit=0.
